---
title: "Selected media and public engagement"
description-meta: "Selected podcasts, interviews and public writing by Hans Fredrik Sunde."
---

The [CV](cv.qmd#media-and-public-engagement) contains the full list.

```{r}
#| results: asis
python <- Sys.getenv("CV_PYTHON")
if (!nzchar(python) || !file.exists(python)) {
  python <- Sys.which("python")
}
if (!nzchar(python)) python <- Sys.which("python3")
if (!nzchar(python)) stop("Python is required to render the CV")
# Read UTF-8 explicitly: capturing stdout as R strings uses the Windows locale.
cv_output <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
cv_status <- system2(python, c("scripts/cv.py", "media"), stdout = cv_output)
if (cv_status != 0L) stop("CV generation failed; see the error above")
cv_html <- readLines(cv_output, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
unlink(cv_output)
cat("```{=html}\n", paste(cv_html, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```
